implementation_status_findings.verified_fact: The current official-linked GitHub repository exposes a README stating that code was under review for copyright/legal purposes; executable implementation was not available from that repository during this verification tranche.
implementation_status_findings.selection_consequence: Do not freeze TabLog as a reproducible executable baseline unless implementation availability is independently resolved and pinned.

implementation_status_findings.verified_fact: The official repository describes MetaBO as a research prototype developed for the publication and states that it will not be maintained or monitored.
implementation_status_findings.selection_consequence: Retain as transfer-relevant historical research evidence; do not assume it is the strongest current comparator solely from publication status.

implementation_status_findings.verified_fact: The official Tent repository is archived and read-only.
implementation_status_findings.selection_consequence: Tent may remain a foundational TTA comparator but archived status and stronger later methods must be considered before claim-bearing selection.

implementation_status_findings.verified_fact: The located PFT3A repository exposes the method implementation but no GitHub releases; the observed repository history contained one commit in the web view used for this tranche.
implementation_status_findings.selection_consequence: A full immutable commit SHA must be resolved before any final retained baseline binding.

role_fit_findings.basis: ReAct interleaves prompted reasoning traces and task actions. The method itself is not evidence of learned cross-family transfer.
Agent Lightning v1.0 is a harnessed agentic-RL framework and reports trained-agent improvements, but a framework package alone is not a concrete claim-bearing baseline.
required_for_final_binding: training data or governed training input identity

role_fit_findings.basis: SWE-agent is specifically designed around software-engineering and repository issue-solving tasks.
not_established: applicability to arbitrary E1 agent tasks

role_fit_findings.basis: GEPA optimizes textual system components through reflective evolution and is directly relevant when the candidate adaptation surface includes prompts, textual policies, instructions, or analogous text components.
Optuna is a hyperparameter-optimization framework. It is relevant when the governed E2 decision problem is hyperparameter/search selection, not automatically as a raw predictive-model baseline.
SMAC3 is a Bayesian-optimization and algorithm-configuration package. Role eligibility depends on E2's governed decision surface.
FLAML is an AutoML system. It is a plausible strong system comparator only for matched AutoML/model-selection tasks and resource regimes.
AutoGluon is a predictive AutoML system. It must not automatically be treated as an N-H1 investigation-decision baseline unless the experiment's decision construct is matched.
TabICLv2 is a tabular foundation model for classification/regression. Strong predictive accuracy does not by itself establish eligibility for a learned investigation-decision claim.
TabPFN is a tabular foundation-model system. Package strength is not automatically equivalent to the Task-8 decision construct.
MetaBO explicitly learns acquisition functions for transfer learning in Bayesian optimization.
not_established: direct applicability to every E2 N-H2 experiment

role_fit_findings.basis: IALE trains a transferable active-learning policy and evaluates application to different image datasets and classifier architectures.
EATA performs test-time adaptation and explicitly introduces regularization to reduce forgetting on in-distribution data.
CoTTA targets continual test-time adaptation and uses stochastic restoration toward source weights to preserve source knowledge.
SAR is an official ICLR 2023 test-time adaptation method designed for dynamic distribution shifts.
FOA is an ICML 2024 test-time adaptation method that performs adaptation using forward passes rather than standard backpropagation.
